name: cut green oak sapling
description: a small, cut, green sapling with light gray, smooth bark
details: A small sapling, cut through close to the ground and lying bent across the soil, the white, five-pointed pith showing at the centre of its clean-cut stump.  Its bark is light gray and smooth.  The wood is still green and heavy with sap, and wilting leaves, bright yellow-green, oblong and seven-lobed, still cling to the twigs.
